Definition: Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Nachash is also the name of two men, and the best known is Nahash the Ammonite who besieged Jabesh-gilead. In 1 Samuel 11:1 Nahash the Ammonite comes up and encamps against Jabesh-gilead, and in 2 Samuel 10:2 David shows kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to David. In 2 Samuel 17:25 Abigail is called the daughter of Nahash, the sister of Zeruiah, Joab's mother.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nahash shows how one name can hold both an enemy and a friend, because the Ammonite king who threatened Israel is also the father remembered with kindness. David did not forget the kindness, and the book does not forget the siege.
